RECOMMENDATIONS.title: Maintain Current Spending Levels
RECOMMENDATIONS.whats_happening: The campaign is generating a high return on investment.

what_you_should_do.how: Keep the budget steady to maintain high revenue generation.
guardrails: Avoid increasing spend without clear evidence of additional returns.

RECOMMENDATIONS.why_this_matters: Sustaining current spending will help continue generating strong profits.

expected_impact.explanation: Maintaining spending will keep the revenue return consistent.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Monitor revenue return per ad dollar and marketing return on investment.
measurement_plan.notes: Watch for any changes in market conditions.

RECOMMENDATIONS.title: Enhance Customer Retention Strategies
RECOMMENDATIONS.whats_happening: The churn rate is low, indicating good retention, but there is always room for improvement.

what_you_should_do.step: Implement loyalty programs or follow-up communications.
what_you_should_do.how: Create initiatives to engage existing customers and encourage repeat purchases.
guardrails: Ensure programs are cost-effective and do not exceed budget.

RECOMMENDATIONS.why_this_matters: Improving retention can lead to increased lifetime customer value and revenue.

expected_impact.explanation: Higher retention rates will boost the overall value of each customer.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Track changes in annual value per customer and customer retention rates.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Increase annual value per customer by 10%.
measurement_plan.notes: Consider seasonality effects on customer behavior.

RECOMMENDATIONS.title: Optimize Ad Creative for Higher Engagement

what_you_should_do.step: Test new ad formats or messaging.
what_you_should_do.how: Experiment with different visuals or copy to see what resonates more with the audience.
guardrails: Do not change the entire campaign at once; test incrementally.

expected_impact.explanation: Better engagement will likely convert more clicks into purchases.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare purchase rates before and after creative changes.

measurement_plan.notes: Monitor for any external factors that may influence results.
